speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam, sounds like perfect weather for sport! Speaking of which, that talent conference we mentioned earlier is huge for Australian sport. Three hundred experts from around the world sharing best practices on developing our future champions.

speaker: alice
text: It's exciting stuff, especially with Brisbane 2032 on the horizon! The Australian Institute of Sport is also ramping up their Share a Yarn program, building leadership and connection with First Nations athletes as mentors.

speaker: charlie
text: Plus Olympic gold medallist Olivia Wunsch has been training at the AIS, chasing those marginal gains ahead of Commonwealth Games and Pan Pacs. Shows our elite athletes are leaving no stone unturned in their preparation.
